# Release notes format

Write public release notes in English. Keep translations of the Home Assistant UI
in `custom_components/yunmi_kettle/translations/`.

Use the title `v<version> – <short description>` with a sentence-case description.
Keep notes concise and focus on meaningful changes for users, following
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/).
Use the structure below. Keep routine test results in CI rather than adding a
`Validation` section. Add upgrade notes or known limitations only when relevant.
This file is a writing template; GitHub does not apply it automatically.

```markdown
## What changed

- Describe each meaningful change in one short bullet.
```
